title: Harpoon SE Implementation Daybook
content:
Purpose: quick daily scratchpad for the Harpoon Logistics private deployment work. Highly iterative notes, action items, and minute config fragments. Not customer-facing.

----
2024-11-10 (kickoff + checklist)
- 09:15 intro call w/ Harpoon infra (Amira, Tom). Took notes on network constraints: no internet egress, strict CIDR ranges, and HSM key policy.
- Confirmed target: VPC private deployment inside Harpoon AWS account (gov-like controls).
- Top-level deliverables: network diagram + VPC peering plan, deployment manifest for private control plane, HSM/KMS integration guide, performance baseline for rw-large-v1 (4k context).
- Quick todos: request Harpoon IAM role (done), ask for list of allowed outbound prefixes (open), request HSM provisioning ETA (open).

Open questions:
- Can Harpoon allow outbound to S3 endpoints for model artifact pull during initial bootstrap? (Amira to confirm)
- Which KMS provider: AWS KMS or Vault HSM? They said 'on-prem HSM' but suggested AWS CloudHSM as fallback. Need exact model + connectivity.

----
2024-11-11 (network + bootstrap notes)
- CIDR constraints: Harpoon said primary CIDR 10.10.0.0/16, restricted to 10.10.0.0/20 for infra. Need to avoid overlap with our control plane IPs (default 10.8.0.0/16). Proposed: use 10.200.0.0/16 for control-plane peering.
- Draft peer plan: create AWS Transit Gateway attachment from Harpoon VPC -> Redwood Transit GW (if allowed), otherwise VPC peering with strict route tables.
- VPN fallback: set up site-to-site VPN using shared key; fall back if TGW is not allowed.

Bootstrap commands (dev notes, not yet prod):
- rwctl auth create --role harpoon-se --external-id HARP-197
- rwctl deploy --target harpoon-account --env private --model rw-large-v1 --replicas 2 --node-type g5.12xlarge --kv-cache enabled

Notes on model selection/quantization:
- For Harpoon realtime cost target we should test int8 quant (LLM.int8) vs FP16. Latency target 150ms p95 for 512 tokens.
- Action: run local benchmark on rw-large-v1 (fp16 vs int8) with batch sizes [1,4] and sequence length profiles from Harpoon logs (avg prompt 180 tokens).

----
2024-11-12 (customer config & security)
- HSM: Harpoon confirms on-prem Thales Luna; wants Redwood to integrate via PKCS#11 over a bastion in their network. Need to provide integration doc + sample PKCS#11 shim.
- Proposed flow: control plane stores encrypted model metadata only; keys stay in Harpoon HSM. We will implement asymmetric sign/verify for deployment tokens.
- Compliance notes: Harpoon requires FIPS 140-2 log entries for any key usage. Add to audit plan.

Action items (owner tags inline):
- [ ] (Ravi) Draft PKCS#11 shim example + sample config for control plane. Due: 2024-11-15.
- [ ] (Lena) Validate node image with FIPS modules enabled. Due: 2024-11-14.
- [ ] (Marcus) Prepare performance harness for int8 vs fp16 tests. Due: 2024-11-13.
- [ ] (Amira / Harpoon) Confirm S3 egress allowance for initial artifact pull. (open)

Quick config snippets to reuse later:
- control_plane_cidr = 10.200.0.0/16
- allowed_harpoon_cidr = 10.10.0.0/20
- bootstrap env vars:
  - REDWOOD_ENV=private
  - REDWOOD_ACCOUNT=harpoon-account-197
  - REDWOOD_REGION=us-west-2

Kubernetes notes (hosted in Harpoon OSP cluster):
- Use nodeSelector: gpu = present
- tolerations: nvidia-gpu:true:NoSchedule
- storageClass: managed-ephemeral-encrypted (must mount EBS with encryption at rest using Harpoon KMS)

----
2024-11-13 (standup sync + experiment plan)
- Standup: Harpoon can provision CloudHSM in 2 weeks if on-prem integration blocked. Keep both flows in parallel.
- Experiment plan for perf: two-phase
  1) synthetic microbenchmarks (rw-large-v1) to measure token throughput on g5.12xlarge and g5.24xlarge with int8 quant
  2) replay traffic from Harpoon sample corpus to measure p95 latency at expected concurrency (10 qps baseline).
- Metrics to capture: p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, GPU utilization, KV cache hit ratio, peak memory footprint, tail latency when batch>1.

Customer-facing checklist to deliver (for later cleanup into Confluence):
- Network diagram + peering type decision
- HSM/KMS integration guide (PKCS#11 example)
- Bootstrap script + IAM role docs
- Performance baseline report (fp16 vs int8)
- Post-install runbook for incident response and model rollback

Notes-to-self:
- Keep scratchpad focused on actionables only; move polished guides into Confluence under confluence/pages/harpoon-onboarding.
- Avoid sharing raw bootstrap commands with Harpoon until we finalize IAM roles.

Fragments and quick reminders:
- Possible fallback model variant: rw-medium-v1 for canary if RW-large int8 shows quality regression.
- Check with infra if g5 node images include CUDA 12 and MPS support.
- Link to sample HSM shim repo: github.com/redwood/samples-hsm (open PR 2103).

----
End of current session. Will append notes from tomorrow's test run and any replies from Harpoon.
